ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels and 35% low-intensity black pixels localized centrally and along leading/trailing margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity black region forming an hourglass shape around the notch; numerous high-contrast black geometric dashes and irregular spots scattered across white lobes; thin black banding along the upper leading edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 135 degrees; depth is approximately 10% of total fluke vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge; significant irregular topography with high-amplitude peaks at both distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep along the leading edges, transitioning to a slight concavity before tapering to the distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dark, roughly circular clusters localized at the distal fluke tips; smaller high-contrast circular spots distributed across the white ventral field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Four distinct parallel dark linear streaks on the right lobe oriented at approximately 45 degrees; two shorter vertical linear marks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent diagonal rake mark scars on the right fluke lobe; irregular, jagged morphology at the right distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique cluster of high-contrast black vertical dashes on the interior medial region of the right lobe.
